dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thin pale fringes on covert feathers creating multiple scalloped horizontal rows rather than a single distinct bar.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp, linear pale boundaries along the outer webs of folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive, high-contrast pale feather margins across the dorsal surface creating a distinct scale-like appearance.
